ModMetaData.name: Auto Flicker
ModMetaData.author: Taranchuk
ModMetaData.description:
[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/Self-Info.png[/img]
Automatically flick/toggle generators and much more!
The Auto Flicker can toggle any building that has the flickable tag, so it should be compatible with any modded buildings.
- Coding done by Taranchuk - Commissioned by Lucky
